name: Blackhole
install:
export PATH="${HOME}/.bun/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
cd /workspace
bun install
if [ -f scripts/cloud-agent-plugins.sh ]; then bash scripts/cloud-agent-plugins.sh || true; fi
start:
export PATH="${HOME}/.bun/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
cd /workspace
if [ -f scripts/cloud-agent-plugins.sh ]; then bash scripts/cloud-agent-plugins.sh || true; fi
